title: A successful cloud-wave run reports stopped, never completed
description: From b6e gap 5. Closeout is mandatory rather than conditional on the cloud-wave path, so even a fully successful wave terminates in state stopped. progress and progress_detail still carry the real evidence, so nothing is lost — but an operator reading state alone sees every successful run as if it had been stopped, which is exactly the kind of misleading-but-technically-true signal that cost this session real time on tk cloud trace (c5i). Either make the terminal state honest or make the discrepancy impossible to misread.
